slot.intent: Who owned the fund: insiders held 62%, other funds 28%, and the small savers who lost everything only 10%.

concept: One row per holder, named as spoken, the block sliding up to keep what is said centred; each bar fills in one stroke and its figure lands at the tip. Red marks the largest; all figures one size.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "Insiders": the first row arrives at the centre of the frame: its label fades in whole and its empty track draws steadily across
1.25 s: as "62%" comes, the red bar starts filling along the track in one stroke, slowing into its share
1.75 s, on "62%,": the bar is all but home as the figure is spoken; 62% lands just past the tip in bold red mono, the size every figure shares
2.6 s, on "funds": the second row arrives below and the block slides up half a row to stay centred; its track draws at the same pace as the first
3.0 s: the second bar fills in grey the same way
3.5 s, on "28%,": the bar settles and 28% lands at its tip in off white, the same size as 62%
4.4 s, on "small": the third row arrives below with its whole label, small savers, and its track draws steadily across
5.6 s: the third bar fills in grey
6.1 s, on "10%.": the last bar settles and 10% lands at its tip
6.5 s: full hold on all three rows, centred, to the end; the camera never moves

leansOn.title: Bar chart (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: Accent on the key bar only, the others soft grey, every figure one size in bold mono, no marks that carry no data.
